notes.title: PATCH NOTE – EPISODE 2 (Beta)
notes.content:
Game development is a long process, but we've reached a key milestone that should please the most impatient players.

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]The final part of the game is fully integrated: no more storyboard placeholders. All the artwork is there—some fully finished, others still in sketch form. (Thanks to the gallery, you’ll be able to revisit your unlocked scenes once they are fully colored.)
[*]Choice trees and dialogues are complete: 3 endings are now available—one major and two minor ones, with subtle variations depending on your decisions.
[*]7 new Steam achievements to show your friends how you completed the story.
[*]2 new sex scenes added, along with some erotic moments sprinkled throughout the adventure.
[/list]

[b]Not done yet:[/b]
[list]
[*]The "bastard" ending is not available yet. The choice leading to it is visible but not clickable.
[*]More stories in the first episode environments.
[/list]

For those who played the secret rough/storyboard version of Episode 2 back in October, I suggest starting from a save before The Last Dinner.

notes.title: Release Notes V00.10.04
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The arcade with the paladin elf offers a better reward with two new animations (already unlocked in the achievements menu if you previously reached the reward).
[*] The paladin is now easier to defeat: she loses in case of a tie with the player.
[*] Dialogues have been improved, especially the final one with Mr. Lee.
[*] An animation is shown when you lose a health point.
[/list]

[h1]Navigation Comfort[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now skip dialogues using the spacebar.
[*] A short delay has been added to prevent accidentally skipping important animations.
[*] Stuttering animation loops on certain PC configurations have been fixed.
[/list]

[h1]Known Bug[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some players experience issues with animation playback. This is a rare bug, and we need feedback: please send your OS, graphics card, or the AppData/LocalLow/Balsagames/Horror in Hongdae/player.log file if you’re unsure of your setup.
[/list]
